Is sajdah sahu be done also if not done whether namaz will be right or not? 19630 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum I am a Hafiz Alhamdulillah, but I have problem pronouncing the Ra sound. There is a joint below the tip of my tongue, which makes my tongue tip-less and I cannot make the Ra sound. Whenever I try to pronounce Ra, the sound of Waw comes out. I have tried a lot of time when I was small, and when I was doing Hifz but it did not improve. Now since I am a Hafiz, I am usually asked to lead the prayer when the Imam is not present in the Masjid. I want to ask whether it is ok if I lead the prayer? I cannot even pronounce Allahu Akbar properly. The sound comes out as Allahu Akbaw, but people usually don't notice. And then there will be many more mistakes in Surah Fatihah. So is my prayer valid? And what about the prayer of those who are praying behind me? I heard one 'Alim say that if Takbeere Tahreema is not proper, then a person will not even enter into the prayer. It is as if he has not started the prayer at all. What should I do then? I cannot pronounce it properly. I hope Allah will accept my prayer because I am ma'zoor, but if I am leading the prayer, will the prayer of those behind me be valid? Jazakallah Khair 2925 views Q. Question: Mufti Sahab & All Brother in Islam Assalamu Alaikum Kya Farmate Hai Ulma e ekram mala e zail ke bare me-: 1.Hamre Masjid Ke Imam sahab ka kehna hai ki Fajr or Isha ki Azaan waqt shuru hune se 3-4 minute pehle di ja sakti hai. 2. Ek Admi mutakil apni dadi french cut rakta hai ,aese admi se azaan dilana kesa hai. Answer ID: 7691 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 969/969=M/1429) (1) The purpose of Azan is to inform that the time of salah has started; this purpose will be in vain if Azan is called before the time and people will fall in misconception. Therefore, it is not right to call Azan before the time begins and if called it will be of no use and it should be called again after the time starts. How does the Imam of your mosque say that Azan can be called three or four minutes before the times of Isha and Fajr? You should have quoted him with reference and proof. (2) It is undesirable to make such a person call Azan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
